card.desc:
## **Lore:**

**“They’re my friends… my precious Harvest!”**

**The stand of Shigekiyo “Shigechi” Yangu. A colony of roughly 500 tiny insect-like units acting as a single will. Each unit is feeble,  But the swarm can scour a entire town for anything of value and overwhelm enemies through sheer numbers.**

## M1 Light Combo & M2 Attack

![m1harvest.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab4352ea6528c9c7a197e4a/attachments/6ab5010cc36188d2cded1f52/previews/6ab50133c36188d2cded4a5f/download/m1harvest.gif)

## **Colony Carry [TAP AGAIN TO STOP]**

**The colony scoops you up and hauls you rapidly across any surface (including walls). Tap again to stop early.**

**Base cooldown: 25s**

![carry2.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab4352ea6528c9c7a197e4a/attachments/6ab4ea0c9343c511212dff9e/previews/6ab4ea3c9343c511212e5b90/download/carry2.gif)

## **Harvest Ambush/RECALL [HOLD]**

**Tap to plant a Harvest squad on a floor, wall, or ceiling. They ambush enemies who come near. Hold to recall your squads. Active ambush squads must be recalled or spent before a normal unsummon. (Procs Poison)**

**Base cooldown: 0.45s**

![harvest2.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab4352ea6528c9c7a197e4a/attachments/6ab4eca4b9cb371525f80606/previews/6ab4ecaeb9cb371525f8146a/download/harvest2.gif)

![poison.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab4352ea6528c9c7a197e4a/attachments/6ab4ecd005ca7d8b9b3faeb8/previews/6ab4ecd105ca7d8b9b3faf63/download/poison.gif)

## Harvest Tornado

**Harvest circles you at high speed, shredding nearby enemies from every direction.**

**Base cooldown: 23s**

![tornadoha.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab4352ea6528c9c7a197e4a/attachments/6ab5019bbf0260236b040052/previews/6ab5019fbf0260236b040339/download/tornadoha.gif)

## Search Party / Command [M1] / Cycle [TAP] /   Recall [HOLD]

**Send all nine Harvest out to search. The enemies, objects and items they find stay marked until you recall them.**

![harvestgo.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab4352ea6528c9c7a197e4a/attachments/6ab502812dc8cefbd383862e/previews/6ab502832dc8cefbd3838abb/download/harvestgo.gif)

# EX [Awakening Moves]

## Poured Into Veins [3 Bars]

**“I poured it into your veins!” All nine Harvest combine into one concealed trap and overwhelm its victim with poisoned stings.**

**Base cooldown: 16s**

![trap.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab4352ea6528c9c7a197e4a/attachments/6ab50465d82227c7ff4d81b0/previews/6ab5046bd82227c7ff4d8b14/download/trap.gif)

##

## You want proof?! [4 Bars]

**Harvest quadruples its ranks and overwhelms one marked enemy.**

**Base cooldown: 35s**

![surround.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab4352ea6528c9c7a197e4a/attachments/6ab5051a8de45362d4a44482/previews/6ab505228de45362d4a44c96/download/surround.gif)

##

## Snatch [2 Bars]

**Send Harvest to take a consumable from an enemy’s hand and bring it back. Getting hit on the way interrupts them and drops anything they took.**

**Base cooldown: 18s**
